meta.title: Readiness — now → January
meta.persistence_note: Checkboxes are NOT saved to your device (no storage is used). Your progress lives in the page URL — use “Copy shareable link” to save it or share the current state with the other riders.

phases.name: Phase 1 — Now → August
phases.subtitle: Lock the trip in. Peak season books out — act early.

items.label: Confirm all 3 riders are committed (dates + budget).
Book transport to Baja + drop-off/pickup (January is peak season — book early).
Tubeless conversion for anyone still running tubes.
Agree the clockwise route + the 9.5-day / 1-rest-day plan.
Divvy up Tier 2 / Tier 3 shared gear — who carries the inReach, stove, trauma kit?

phases.name: Phase 2 — September → October
phases.subtitle: Shake the rig down loaded, then close the gaps it reveals.

items.label: Loaded shakedown overnighter on the ACTUAL rigs (full kit, full water).
Buy redundancy gaps the shakedown reveals.
Verify cold-rated sleep systems handle ~40°F / 5°C nights.
Confirm 4–6 L water capacity per rider works with the chosen bags/cages.
Dial bike fit + contact points over a long day before it matters.
Re-download the current GPX — the route has live reroutes.
Confirm entry docs + Mexican tourist permit (FMM) for all 3 riders.
Arrange bike-box transport + Ventanas basecamp staging.
Confirm drop-off logistics for the San José del Cabo start.
Download offline maps + this site to every phone.
Sealant top-up on all tires.
Drivetrain / brake pads / tires inspected + serviced.
Device-charging / battery-bank plan confirmed (inReach, phones, lights).
Print offline materials (gear checklist + 1-page itinerary brief).
Final shared-gear check — confirm who is actually carrying what.
